text: Opens Delta Lake table stored, 'Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2', 'Azure Blob Storage' local disk, returns table's log records data frames: versions commits, files version partition values, statistics deletion vectors, schema, protocol properties, changes two versions. Reads table's data , pruning files partition values statistics downloading . log replayed 'R', following Delta Lake protocol https://github.com/delta-io/delta/blob/master/PROTOCOL.md.
